entry.name: rnbo_average_absolute~
entry.digest: Maintain a running average of the absolute value of incoming values
entry.description: Performs an absolute average on the input signal based on a given window size. The resulting output not only represents the mean value over a window of samples, but also the output of a basic low-pass FIR filter.

arguments.name: windowSize
arguments.description: The number of samples to be averaged together at once
